name: Cross Guard
description: Cross Guard plugin for Mattermost Federal.

settings_schema.header: Cross-domain message relay for Mattermost Federal. [View full documentation](/plugins/crossguard/public/help/help.html).

settings.help_text: When enabled, inbound messages will be posted as the matching local user if a user with the same username exists. When disabled, a synthetic relay user is always created.

settings.display_name: Restrict Connection Management to System Admins
settings.help_text: When enabled, only system admins can link or unlink connections to teams and channels. When disabled, team admins can manage team connections and channel admins can manage channel connections.

settings.display_name: Allow Team Admins to Request Connections
settings.help_text: When enabled (and 'Restrict Connection Management to System Admins' is also enabled), team admins can submit connection link requests for system admin approval via direct message and can unlink connections directly. When disabled, team admins are blocked entirely.
